title: Just pain
description: This datapack makes minecraft borderline unplayable.
body:
# Datapack Name: Pain

## Description
This datapack introduces a Challenge to Minecraft. Originally tested in a private Discord server, it officially launched on Modrinth in version 1.3.0.

## Features

- **Effects:**
  - **Weakness I**: Reduces player damage (Nerfed from Weakness II in version 1.3.1).
  - **Mining Fatigue II**: Slows down mining speed.
  - **Hunger I**: Increases hunger depletion rate.

- **Lava Lakes:**
  - 50% chance of generating in each chunk (introduced in version 1.3.0, I have no idea how to make them spawn naturally.).

- **Armor Unwearable:**
  - Added in version 1.3.0 but removed in version 1.3.1 due to errors.

## Version History
- **Private Versions (Pre-1.3.0)**: Tested within a private Discord server.
- **1.3.0**: First public release on Modrinth; added lava lakes and the unwearable armor feature.
- **1.3.1**: Removed the unwearable armor feature due to errors. `Weakness II` -> `Weakness I`
- **1.4.0**: `Hunger II` -> `Hunger I`, Added halved hearts.

## Installation Instructions
1. Download the datapack file.
2. Place the file in the `datapacks` folder of your Minecraft world save.
3. Load the world or use the `/reload` command to activate the datapack.

## Changelog
- **1.3.0**: Added lava lakes and unwearable armor feature.
- **1.3.1**: Removed unwearable armor feature due to errors. `Weakness II` -> `Weakness I`
- **1.4.0**: `Hunger II` -> `Hunger I`, Added halved hearts.
